activity.notes: Cambridge's Everyday Life in the Aztec World identifies Ahuitzotl as the Aztec king and emperor who reigned from 1486 to 1502. ATLAS reuses the same Aztec Empire / rules / Huey Tlatoani / reign modeling precedent already used for Moctezuma I and II, avoiding a competing Mexico-Tenochtitlan polity identity for this ruler.

sources.title: The Emperor — Everyday Life in the Aztec World
sources.citation_text: Frances F. Berdan and Michael E. Smith's Cambridge chapter treats the life of Aztec king and emperor Ahuitzotl and gives his reign as 1486-1502.
